title: From lasers to code
paragraphs: I studied physical engineering and nanotechnology at Brno University of Technology and spent my PhD running absorption spectroscopy experiments. Somewhere along the way I realised that programming was the part I enjoyed most.

Since May 2024 I work as a software engineer. I started with web scraping in Python and moved on to chatbots that answer from client data. I care about code I can take responsibility for once it is deployed.
Outside of work I play chess, floorball and football.
